summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, attaching an investor presentation used at a meeting with investors. The presentation discusses structural changes in electricity generation, renewable energy growth, and the company's operational and financial roadmap, including projected annual recurring revenues and global operating capacity. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine investor communication.
